# Julia 实现：主题模型 {#sec-topicmodeling-julia}

本章用 Julia 重现第 \@ref(sec-topicmodeling) 章的"图书馆大捣乱"例子。Julia 端用 **TextAnalysis.jl** 的 `lda()` 函数（原生 LDA 实现），纯 Julia FMM 分词，**CairoMakie.jl** 绘图。

> TextAnalysis.jl 的 `lda` 返回 `(beta, gamma)`，其中 beta 是主题×词概率矩阵，gamma 是文档×主题概率矩阵。与 R `tidy(lda, matrix=...)` 的 tidy 格式不同，需要手动转换为 DataFrame。

## 准备数据

从 parquet 读取六部小说，分词，按回分成独立文档。

```{julia}
include("data/jieba_fmm.jl")
using DataFrames, Parquet2, TextAnalysis, StatsBase
using CairoMakie
CairoMakie.activate!()
set_theme!(fonts = (regular = "Microsoft YaHei", bold = "Microsoft YaHei"))

dict = load_dict("data/jieba_dict.txt")
stopwords = load_stopwords("data/stop_word_zh.utf8")

books = DataFrame(Parquet2.Dataset("data/common/books.parquet"))
println("书名: ", sort(unique(books.title)))

# 分词 + 移除停止词
function segment_clean(text, dict, stopwords)
    ismissing(text) && return String[]
    return [w for w in fmm_segment(text, dict) if !isempty(strip(w)) && !(strip(w) in stopwords)]
end

books.words = segment_clean.(books.text, Ref(dict), Ref(stopwords))
```

按回分文档（等价于 R 的 `cumsum(str_detect(...))`）：

```{julia}
chapter_re = r"^第[零一二三四五六七八九十百 ]+回"

doc_names = String[]
doc_words = Vector{String}[]

for sub in groupby(books, :title)
    title = sub.title[1]
    chapter_num = 0
    for row in eachrow(sub)
        text = coalesce(row.text, "")
        if occursin(chapter_re, text)
            chapter_num += 1
        end
        if chapter_num > 0
            push!(doc_names, "$(title)_$(chapter_num)")
            push!(doc_words, row.words)
        end
    end
end

println("文档数: ", length(doc_names))
println("示例: ", doc_names[1], " => ", doc_words[1][1:min(10,end)])
```

## 构建 DTM 并运行 LDA

```{julia}
# 用 TextAnalysis 的 StringDocument + Corpus 构建 DTM
docs = [StringDocument(join(ws, " ")) for ws in doc_words]
crps = Corpus(docs)
update_lexicon!(crps)
dtm = DocumentTermMatrix(crps)
println("DTM: ", size(dtm.dtm), ", 词汇表: ", length(crps.lexicon))

# LDA k=6（等价于 R LDA(chapters_dtm, k=6, seed=1234)）
# lda 返回 (ϕ=beta: ntopics×nwords, θ=gamma: ntopics×ndocs)
beta_matrix, gamma_matrix = lda(dtm, 6, 30, 0.1, 0.1; showprogress = false)
println("beta: ", size(beta_matrix), ", gamma: ", size(gamma_matrix))
```

## 词-主题概率（beta）

```{julia}
# 归一化为概率
beta_norm = beta_matrix ./ sum(beta_matrix, dims = 2)
lexicon_list = collect(keys(crps.lexicon))

# 每个主题 top 5 词
for t in 1:6
    top5 = sortperm(beta_norm[t, :], rev = true)[1:5]
    words = [lexicon_list[i] for i in top5]
    println("主题$t: ", join(words, ", "))
end
```

各主题最高词可视化（等价于图 \@ref(fig-toptermsplot)）：

```{julia}
#| label: fig-toptermsplot-jl
#| fig-cap: "每个主题中最常见的术语（Julia）"
set_theme!(fonts = (regular = "Microsoft YaHei", bold = "Microsoft YaHei"))

fig = Figure(size = (700, 800))
for t in 1:6
    top5 = sortperm(beta_norm[t, :], rev = true)[1:5]
    words = [lexicon_list[i] for i in top5]
    vals = beta_norm[t, top5]
    # sort ascending for barh display
    perm = sortperm(vals)
    ax = Axis(fig[((t-1)÷2)+1, ((t-1)%2)+1]; title = "主题$t", xlabel = "beta",
              yticks = (collect(1:5), words[perm]))
    barplot!(ax, collect(1:5), collect(vals[perm]); direction = :x)
end
fig
```

## 文档-主题概率（gamma）

```{julia}
# 拆分文档名
doc_info = DataFrame(document = doc_names)
doc_info.title = [join(split(n, "_")[1:end-1], "_") for n in doc_names]
doc_info.chapter = [parse(Int, split(n, "_")[end]) for n in doc_names]

# gamma 是 ntopics×ndocs，转置为 ndocs×ntopics
gamma_df = DataFrame(Matrix(gamma_matrix'), ["主题$i" for i in 1:6])
gamma_df = hcat(doc_info, gamma_df)
first(gamma_df, 5)
```

每本书在各主题上的 gamma 分布（等价于图 \@ref(fig-chaptersldagamma)）：

```{julia}
#| label: fig-chaptersldagamma-jl
#| fig-cap: "每本书中每章的 gamma 概率（Julia）"
set_theme!(fonts = (regular = "Microsoft YaHei", bold = "Microsoft YaHei"))

titles = sort(unique(gamma_df.title))
fig = Figure(size = (800, 800))
for (i, title) in enumerate(titles)
    sub = filter(:title => ==(title), gamma_df)
    ax = Axis(fig[((i-1)÷2)+1, ((i-1)%2)+1]; title = title, xlabel = "章", ylabel = "gamma")
    for t in 1:6
        scatter!(ax, sub.chapter, sub[:, "主题$t"]; alpha = 0.5, markersize = 4,
                 label = "主题$t")
    end
end
fig
```

## R vs Julia 对比

| 任务 | R | Julia |
|---|---|---|
| 分词 | jiebaR `worker()` | 纯 Julia FMM `fmm_segment()` |
| DTM 构建 | `cast_dtm()` | `DocumentTermMatrix(Corpus)` |
| LDA | `topicmodels::LDA()` | `TextAnalysis.lda(dtm, k, ...)` |
| beta 提取 | `tidy(lda, matrix="beta")` | `beta_matrix` 归一化 |
| gamma 提取 | `tidy(lda, matrix="gamma")` | `gamma_matrix` |
| 绘图 | ggplot2 `facet_wrap()` | CairoMakie subplots |

TextAnalysis.jl 的 LDA 使用Collapsed Gibbs Sampling，与 R topicmodels 的 VEM 算法不同，超参数（alpha, beta）也需手动指定。结果不会完全一致，但主题-书的对应关系应类似。FMM 分词精度较低也会影响 LDA 结果，未登录词被拆成单字会增加噪声。
